title: Bashar: What Happens After Death? | Darryl Anka | Channeled Message
author: Free Vibration
opening_summary: Bashar explains that death is not final—even when someone passes physically, they retain the choice to continue living. Many people have actually died but chose to continue in parallel realities without remembering the experience. He describes 'close calls' as moments when individuals died and were offered a choice by their guides to either continue or move to parallel realities. The core teaching emphasizes that if you're still alive, you chose to be here for a reason. Your presence indicates something important awaits you that justifies remaining in physical form rather than transitioning to the non-physical realm.

quotes.quote: Even when someone dies physically you are actually still given a choice to continue
You may have actually died but then chosen to continue in a parallel reality
If you are still here you must have made a choice that continuing is part of evolution
You have to trust that your life will show you what you wanted to be here for
